entities.title: Conformance material
entities.summary: Language-neutral test material shared by every implementation: structural examples, executable operation fixtures, a demo zone-rule bundle and semantic scenarios.
entities.purpose: Holds what every implementation is tested against, so that the five libraries, and any outside implementation, agree. The libraries read these files in place from the repository root; nothing here is copied into a library.
boundaries: Part of the specification: it moves with the specification's version number (VERSIONING.md).
Data only: tools/validate.py checks its structure, and each library's own tests check behaviour against it.
